scope: Unknown-transport, unconfirmed-completion and raw-retention failures through the accepted persistent controller for close modes m4a, m4b and xs with a valid operational allowlist

F2.fault: fake transport unconfirmed (nonzero status, empty stdout)

invariants: Status HELD in all 9; never RELEASED
1 claim and 1 fake transport per case
TERMINAL disposition HOLD, releaseRequested false; no RELEASE_REQUEST
Lock directory and owner record retained
Second run refused before claim with CONTROLLER_EPOCH_HELD; zero new claims, transports or files
Held-lock report stable across two reads, names the attempt, releaseAuthorized and executionReady false, writes nothing

findings.detail: Held-lock report v11 semantics.mjs:13 rejects NATIVE_RECEIPT without a prior RAW row as UNSUPPORTED_SEQUENCE. The core legitimately writes that sequence on raw-retention failure (lib.mjs:869 sets WRITE_FAILED, lib.mjs:875 appends the native receipt). The report stays read-only and conservative but cannot bind the evidence for this case.
findings.next: Candidate narrow held-report revision after the process-kill matrix

limits: Trusted synthetic callbacks and fake IO only; no host effects or operational authority.
Close modes with a valid allowlist only; allowlist faults were not combined with transport/raw faults.
Exceptions and fake outcomes, not process kill or power loss (process kill is packet CR5).
Held locks stay held; no reconciliation or unlock API exists.
next: CR5 actual process-kill matrix through the persistent controller.
